gotchas: Sign-in at auth.monday.com/login is email-first: #user_email then Enter, then #user_password then Enter. Both steps submit on Enter; there is no submit button to click.
A sign-in from a new browser lands on a 'New login detected' step asking for a code mailed to the account owner (one input[type=text], Enter submits). The code is the owner's to supply.

Signed in, the workspace sits under an invite-teammates dialog and a board-setup wizard whose overlay swallows clicks (click timeouts on See plans). Close each dialog by its aria-label close button, then 'See plans' opens the plan picker.

The plan picker has one 'Continue' button per paid plan; nth=0 is the cheapest (Basic). It opens a payment form in the same page: card number and security code each in their own iframe (title contains 'card number' / 'security code', one input each, the CVC input is name=cvc), expiry is a plain MM/YY input on the page. The submit reads Purchase / Complete / Pay.

Verified 2026-10-09 through the staging proxy with the public test card under a verification-only key: number, expiry and CVC filled (card_fields_verified), no aria-invalid. Stopped before the purchase click.

route.note: Signed in, the workspace loads on the account's own subdomain (<account>.monday.com), under an invite-teammates dialog and a board-setup wizard. Close the dialog with its close button ([role=dialog] button[aria-label*=close i]); the wizard's overlay can block clicks until its own aria-label button closes it.
